args: const fs=require("fs");const path=require("path");const dir="tests/models/classic_data";const r=/(.{11})(.{44})(.{12})(.{36})(.{23})(.{5})(.{10})(.{1})(.{15})(.{12})(.{30})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{4})(.{5})(.{6})(.{1})(.{8})(.{2})(.{15})(.{12})(.{30})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{5})(.{4})(.{5})(.{6})(.{1})(.{8})(.{2})(.{57})(.{56})(.{8})(.{8})/;let rows=[];for(const file of fs.readdirSync(dir)){for(const chunk of fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,file),"utf8").match(/(.{587})/g)||[]){if(!chunk.trim())continue;const m=chunk.match(r);if(!m)continue;const f=m.slice(1,43).map(v=>v.replace(/  +/g," ").trim());const n=i=>f[i]===""?NaN:Number(f[i]);const web=n(5),w0=n(11),q0=n(19),o0=n(20),l0=n(18),w1=n(26),q1=n(34),o1=n(35),l1=n(33);if(![web,w0,q0,o0,l0].every(Number.isFinite)||o0<1)continue;const second=[w1,q1,o1,l1].every(Number.isFinite)&&o1>0;let candidates=[];for(let a=1;a<=5;a++)for(let b=second?1:0;b<=(second?5:0);b++){const used=a*w0+(second?b*w1:0);if(used>web)continue;const run=Math.max(Math.ceil(q0*l0/(a*10000)),second?Math.ceil(q1*l1/(b*10000)):0);candidates.push({a,b,run,used});}const bestRun=Math.min(...candidates.map(c=>c.run));const ties=candidates.filter(c=>c.run===bestRun);const usedCurrent=w0*o0+(second?w1*o1:0);const chosen=ties.find(c=>c.a===o0&&c.b===(second?o1:0));const maxUsed=Math.max(...ties.map(c=>c.used));rows.push({file,setup:f[2],outs:[o0,second?o1:0],bestRun,tieCount:ties.length,currentUsed:usedCurrent,maxTieUsed:maxUsed,isMaxWidthTie:usedCurrent===maxUsed,chosenIsMinRun:Boolean(chosen),tieOuts:ties.map(c=>[c.a,c.b])});}}const notMax=rows.filter(x=>!x.isMaxWidthTie);const mult=rows.filter(x=>x.tieCount>1);console.log(JSON.stringify({records:rows.length,allSelectMinRun:rows.every(x=>x.chosenIsMinRun),multipleMinRunTies:mult.length,currentChoosesMaxWidthAmongTies:rows.length-notMax.length,notMaxWidthTies:notMax.slice(0,20),tieExamples:mult.slice(0,12)},null,2));
